title: PoolToken (pool composition leg)
description: One side of a pool's composition: which token sits in the pool and in what amount. Pool composition is a LIST of these, never two fixed columns, because a Balancer weighted pool holds up to 8 legs and a Curve metapool holds 2-4 with a rate oracle. ABSENT AS A ROW TODAY: data.pool stores exactly two sides as base_asset_id/quote_asset_id plus base_symbol/quote_symbol, so a >2-leg pool cannot be represented and a 2-leg pool's composition is inferred from the pair rather than stored. This schema is the shape a composition row must take; the existing two-column form is a lossy projection of it.

leg_index.description: Position in the pool's own leg order, so a consumer comparing two snapshots compares like with like.
